segments.expected: "I sat in the front row of the Long Terrace and watched a second-year lift three-forty. He did it rather well. I clapped." Perrin looked at the jersey. "I'm to lift nothing until the strapping's off. That's the twentieth of next month, and then it's a pail, and then two pails. I'm to stand no floor before the new year. I asked whether I might call off from a chair, and the healer said that he supposed nobody could stop me."
